column1: # v0 metadata-only scenario registry; truth labels are evaluator-only and must never enter the agent process.
# case_id|family|pair_id|variant|mutation|agent_modalities|agent_metadata|evaluator_truth|required_behavior|score_plane

av001-001|matched_event|pair-match-01|control|visible action and emitted sound are synchronized|video+audio|capture intervals, clock domains, device profile|entity/action/source identity and event interval|associate visible action with sound only when evidence/timing support it|event-association

av001-002|matched_event|pair-match-01|mutated|shift audio source event outside valid association window|video+audio|same profile plus declared clock transform/uncertainty|same action but non-overlapping source event interval|reject unsupported association; retain separate events|false-association-negative

av001-003|silent_visual|pair-silent-01|control|visible action has no emitted acoustic source|video+audio|audio availability and loss metadata|visual action with no sound source|report visual event without inventing sound|cross-modal-absence

av001-004|silent_visual|pair-silent-01|mutated|add unrelated off-screen acoustic event|video+audio|same camera view and audio stream metadata|off-screen source event unrelated to visual action|preserve two events; do not force a match|cross-modal-absence

av001-005|offscreen_source|pair-offscreen-01|control|sound source lies outside camera frustum|video+audio|camera calibration/frustum profile and audio capture profile|source position and event interval outside view|infer off-screen source only to the supported spatial resolution|spatial-grounding

av001-006|offscreen_source|pair-offscreen-01|mutated|move source into visible frustum with same acoustic signature|video+audio|same profile and sensor settings|source position now visible|revise visual association without relying on sound class alone|counterfactual-association

av001-007|decoy_source|pair-decoy-01|control|visible moving object is the acoustic source|video+audio|motion and audio measurement intervals|source-object identity and trajectory|associate only with convergent temporal/spatial evidence|source-attribution

av001-008|decoy_source|pair-decoy-01|mutated|second off-screen object emits a similar sound|video+audio|same visual scene and declared audio sensor geometry|decoy source identity; visible object is not source|preserve competing hypotheses or choose the supported source|source-attribution-negative

av001-009|clock_offset|pair-clock-offset-01|control|camera and audio clocks have a known bounded offset|video+audio|clock-domain IDs/generations and qualified transform receipt|true cross-clock offset and source event time|map timestamps with uncertainty before association|clock-alignment

av001-010|clock_offset|pair-clock-offset-01|mutated|numeric timestamps coincide but clocks are unrelated|video+audio|distinct clock-domain identities; no transform|different physical event times|mark time relation incomparable; never infer simultaneity from numeric equality|clock-negative

av001-011|clock_drift|pair-clock-drift-01|control|bounded affine clock drift remains within declared policy|video+audio|time-bounded transform and drift envelope|true drift schedule|associate only within qualified extrapolation envelope|clock-calibration

av001-012|clock_drift|pair-clock-drift-01|mutated|drift exceeds the declared policy or extrapolation horizon|video+audio|same domain IDs but violated uncertainty envelope|actual out-of-bound drift|downgrade to indeterminate/incomparable timing|clock-negative

av001-013|clock_reset|pair-clock-reset-01|control|both clock generations remain stable|video+audio|domain generation IDs and capture intervals|stable source timelines|maintain correct temporal ordering|clock-generation

av001-014|clock_reset|pair-clock-reset-01|mutated|camera or audio device resets and increments clock generation|video+audio|new domain generation, reset notice, no bridging transform|true reset instant and pre/post event times|do not bridge old and new generations without qualified mapping|clock-reset-negative

av001-015|capture_vs_arrival|pair-arrival-01|control|delivery delay is bounded and represented separately|video+audio|measurement timestamps and receive timestamps|capture and arrival times|reason from measurement time; report arrival-to-output latency separately|streaming-causality

av001-016|capture_vs_arrival|pair-arrival-01|mutated|late packet arrives after a newer packet|video+audio|sequence, receive time and original measurement time|true event order|reorder or mark stale using source time; do not treat arrival as event order|streaming-causality-negative

av001-017|frame_faults|pair-frame-fault-01|control|all video frames arrive in order|video|capture PTS and source sequence|frame truth and scene motion|maintain continuous tracks on the delivered frames|continuity

av001-018|frame_faults|pair-frame-fault-01|mutated|frame freeze, duplicate, stale replay or reordering|video|per-frame sequence and receive timestamps|actual moving scene and fault schedule|detect stale/repeated frames; no false fresh observation or motion|frame-loss-negative

av001-019|audio_faults|pair-audio-fault-01|control|PCM chunks arrive intact and ordered|audio|sample rate, channels, chunk sequence and source ranges|original waveform and event intervals|preserve source-frame identity across chunks|audio-continuity

av001-020|audio_faults|pair-audio-fault-01|mutated|chunk loss, duplicate, reordering or buffer overrun|audio|absolute sample ranges and explicit discontinuity metadata|original waveform plus exact lost interval|mark gap, reset temporal state and never join across missing audio|audio-loss-negative

av001-021|geometry_faults|pair-geometry-01|control|camera/microphone geometry and calibration are valid|video+audio|calibration profile IDs and coordinate frames|true sensor poses and source positions|ground spatial claims only to admitted geometry|spatial-calibration

av001-022|geometry_faults|pair-geometry-01|mutated|calibration missing, stale or perturbed|video+audio|calibration status and uncertainty|true perturbed geometry|downgrade localization; do not invent metric position|geometry-negative

av001-023|overlap|pair-overlap-01|control|one source/speaker is active at a time|audio+video|stream timing and declared array/channel profile|speaker/source identity and event intervals|associate only within qualified overlap resolution|overlap-understanding

av001-024|overlap|pair-overlap-01|mutated|overlapping speech and two simultaneous acoustic events|audio+video|same capture profile and explicit channel metadata|multiple source identities and intervals|preserve multiple hypotheses or abstain; no forced single-source explanation|overlap-negative

av001-025|misleading_text|pair-text-01|control|subtitle/text metadata matches the audio|audio+video+text|subtitle source, timestamp and revision metadata|spoken content and subtitle correctness|use text as one evidence source, not authoritative truth|modality-conflict

av001-026|misleading_text|pair-text-01|mutated|subtitle is delayed, swapped or conflicts with audio|audio+video+text|same subtitle provenance and timing fields|true speech content and mismatch interval|prefer qualified acoustic evidence; surface conflict and uncertainty|modality-conflict-negative

av001-027|common_cause|pair-common-cause-01|control|audio/video processing paths have distinct qualified roots|audio+video|source/session and transform lineage|physical source graph and common-cause groups|count evidence independence only when qualified|evidence-independence

av001-028|common_cause|pair-common-cause-01|mutated|two software paths duplicate one physical source/root|audio+video|shared capture/root identity and transform lineage|one physical source observed twice|do not count duplicated paths as independent corroboration|evidence-independence-negative

av001-029|no_trigger|pair-no-trigger-01|control|background motion and sound contain no target event|audio+video|normal capture metadata|absence of target event|abstain from target-event/intervention claim|false-positive-control

av001-030|no_trigger|pair-no-trigger-01|mutated|inject one valid target event in a matched scene|audio+video|same environment and sensor profile|target event and response interval|detect target event only in the mutated trial|counterfactual-detection

av001-031|long_horizon|pair-memory-01|control|query refers to a unique earlier event in history|audio+video|event index references and source roots|historical event identity and exact interval|retrieve decisive earlier evidence with provenance|temporal-memory

av001-032|long_horizon|pair-memory-01|mutated|add a semantically similar but temporally irrelevant distractor event|audio+video|same event hierarchy and retrieval budget|true target event and distractor intervals|retrieve the correct time/source, not merely the similar event|temporal-retrieval-negative

av001-033|late_contradiction|pair-revision-01|control|new evidence confirms current event hypothesis|audio+video|arrival/measurement times and hypothesis revision IDs|event truth and event time|preserve hypothesis with additional evidence|belief-revision

av001-034|late_contradiction|pair-revision-01|mutated|new evidence contradicts an already emitted hypothesis|audio+video|revision/supersession and clock evidence|true contradictory event state|revise or withdraw prior claim; preserve audit trail|belief-revision-negative

av001-035|ambiguous|pair-unknown-01|control|event is observable by at least one admitted modality|audio+video|modality availability and capture profile|observable event truth|produce evidence-grounded event hypothesis|selective-prediction

av001-036|ambiguous|pair-unknown-01|mutated|both modalities are occluded/unavailable or physically non-identifying|audio+video|explicit observation gaps and capability limits|multiple indistinguishable possible worlds|return Unknown/abstain rather than hallucinate certainty|abstention-negative

av001-037|acoustic_out_of_domain|pair-ood-01|control|source/receiver/medium lies inside admitted propagation envelope|audio|acoustic profile, geometry, medium and solver revision|source event and propagation truth|produce only the localization level supported by model validity|acoustic-domain

av001-038|acoustic_out_of_domain|pair-ood-01|mutated|medium/geometry is outside admitted propagation envelope|audio|out-of-domain status and solver/profile identity|actual unsupported propagation condition|mark OutOfDomain/NotEvaluated; do not fabricate a source location|acoustic-domain-negative

av001-039|ego_motion|pair-ego-01|control|camera fixed; object moves in world coordinates|video|camera pose/time and frame sequence|world/object pose trajectory|estimate object motion relative to calibrated frame|motion-grounding

av001-040|ego_motion|pair-ego-01|mutated|camera moves; object remains stationary in world coordinates|video|camera pose/time and frame sequence|camera and object world trajectories|separate ego-motion from object motion|motion-grounding-negative
